40b4a3598da1364e4d6ec9d1c8ff8ee01cbc347c.summary: IBM X-Force IRIS reports on ITG07, which has intruded into geographically dispersed transportation-sector organisations over the past nine months. The report says ITG07 most closely aligns with activity other vendors call Chafer or APT39, a group Symantec describes as an alleged Iran-based hacking group linked to aviation intrusions. This is a correlation, not a confirmed match. The custom backdoor TREKX was also reported by NCCGroup in March 2019 as Chafer activity. ITG07 is described as using Mimikatz, NBTScan, PsExec, webshells, BITS and Citrix access. The initial compromise vector was…
